implementationMessage: The leaked YouTube API key has been revoked by the project owner. The repository no longer contains an obvious hard-coded Google API key, the server syntax issue is repaired, and the initial CI validation passed. A replacement YOUTUBE_API_KEY still needs to be configured in the runtime environment and the YouTube API flows need an end-to-end validation before release.
safetyMessage: REVIEW: the exposed credential has been revoked and no obvious hard-coded Google API key remains on the current main branch. Automated syntax/secret checks previously passed. Final SAFE approval is pending runtime configuration of a replacement YOUTUBE_API_KEY and verification that live-status, upcoming-streams, and channel-by-url flows work without regression.
